deferred_doctrine_states.DETERIORATING: DEFERRED_NOT_OPERATIONALIZED: directional deltas remain observations; no combination threshold is frozen.
deferred_doctrine_states.FAILED: DEFERRED_NOT_OPERATIONALIZED: no causal failure predicate is frozen; A+B coexistence is not promoted to FAILED.
deferred_doctrine_states.HEALTHY_TREND: DEFERRED_NOT_OPERATIONALIZED: absence of damage is not positive trend evidence.

persistent_overlays.clearing: Clear at the first later decision row where memory_seen == true; lifecycle end terminates observation without synthesizing a recovery event.
persistent_overlays.persistence: Once activated within a lifecycle, remain active on later eligible decision rows while memory_seen == false.

persistent_overlays.clearing: Inactive when a_condition_now becomes false; a_condition_recovered_now records the source-native recovery boundary when available.
persistent_overlays.persistence: Active on every consecutive eligible decision row where a_condition_now remains true. a_condition_true_run_length is descriptive only and has no cutoff.

persistent_overlays.clearing: Inactive when b_condition_now becomes false; b_condition_recovered_now records the source-native recovery boundary when available.
persistent_overlays.persistence: Active on every consecutive eligible decision row where b_condition_now remains true. b_condition_true_run_length is descriptive only and has no cutoff.
